SYNTHETIC NOTE - NOT REAL PATIENT DATA.
Ms. A is a 77-year-old woman returning to the memory clinic with her daughter.
Cognition: MMSE 22/30 today, down from 26 eighteen months ago. Clock drawing impaired.
Assessment: findings are consistent with dementia, likely Alzheimer's type.
Labs: HbA1c 7.8 % (up from 7.1). No evidence of delirium at this visit.
Plan: start donepezil 5 mg nightly, recheck in 3 months.

SYNTHETIC NOTE - NOT REAL PATIENT DATA.
Mr. B, 84, brought in by his son after a mechanical fall at home last week.
Cognitive screen: MMSE 29/30 - within normal limits for education level.
There is no evidence of dementia on today's assessment.
He was seen in an inpatient visit last year for pneumonia.
Frailty noted; gait speed markedly reduced.
